mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_TYPE = 'PERSONAL' AND STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER m JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID WHERE m.MEMBER_TYPE = 'LAWYER' AND m.STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN' AND l.APPROVE_STATUS = 'APPROVED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CASE WHERE STEP = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'MM-DD') AS "date", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 4 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'MM-DD') ORDER BY "date" ASC
